تستجوبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَجْوِبُوا (tastajwibū) /tas.tad͡ʒ.wi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# تُسْتَجْوَبُوا (tustajwabū) /tus.tad͡ʒ.wa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
